6240.title: Asset trees abort skill staging
6240.rootCauseOneLine: A fixed decoded-tree byte guard rejects supporting assets and required-tree staging rethrows the error for the whole catalog.
6240.proposedFix: Choose an owner-controlled resource and required-skill failure policy, then implement bounded asset staging and actionable size diagnostics without weakening validation.
6240.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted source checkouts at the host-staging boundary. No desktop UI or provider turn was exercised. No PR: resource safeguards and required-instruction failure semantics require a product policy decision. Repro code and selected output are inline under the reports repository artifact policy.
